stem: Priya keeps one variegated leaf of her potted money plant in sunlight for six hours, and keeps a similar leaf from the same plant fully covered in darkness. She then tests both leaves with iodine solution. In which parts will she detect starch?

options.text: Starch is detected only in the originally non-green patches of the sunlit leaf.
Starch is detected in the green patches of the sunlit leaf, but not in the non-green patches or in the leaf kept in the dark.
Starch is detected in both the green and non-green patches of the sunlit leaf.
Starch is detected in the leaf kept in the dark, but not in the sunlit leaf.

teacher.key_rationale: Starch forms only where chlorophyll-containing green tissue receives sunlight: green patches of the sunlit leaf test positive with iodine; non-green patches lack sufficient chlorophyll and the dark-kept leaf receives no light, so both test negative. Option B is correct.
